verdict.rationale: Codex plugins/skills are explicitly designed to be triggered by natural-language description matching (skill creator asks 'when it should trigger'), and skills can be invoked either automatically or via natural mentions ($skill, /skills) rather than rigid syntax, with a real cross-harness install confirmed at runtime. Missing for 10: independent evidence of how reliably natural-language triggering (vs explicit slash/$ commands) actually invokes skills in practice, and broader coverage beyond skill/plugin installation commands.
